title: Competitive landscape & our edge (why we win, what it costs)
intro: We’re not trying to be the cheapest. We’re trying to be the most reliable studio that still feels premium. The battlefield is simple: the cheaper you go, the more disputes and rework you absorb. Our edge is operational certainty — fit-first + hygiene SLA + dispute-proof handover — so each booking produces repeatable margin and reviews.

positioning.whereWeCompete: We compete in the ‘reliability premium’ lane: customers pay slightly more because risk is lower. For weddings, risk reduction is worth real money.
positioning.whatWeWontDo: We won’t win price wars or accept chaotic bookings that damage inventory and brand. We’ll choose consistency, weekday utilization, and partner funnels instead.

battlefields.title: Price-driven competitors (Budget Rack)
ourCounter: We reduce risk with structured fittings and evidence-based handover
We price for readiness: cleaned, pressed, confirmed fit — not just a garment on a hanger

battlefields.title: Typical boutique (Taste + service)
hiddenCosts: Often high rent + higher headcount early
Ops inconsistency: depends on staff mood/skill
ourCounter: Standardized SOP so quality is repeatable
Weekday products (civil/ROM + photoshoot packages) to fill quiet days

battlefields.title: Studio bundle / photo-first
hiddenCosts: Weak moat if everyone can bundle
ourCounter: We still partner — but we keep pricing integrity via tiered packages
Our moat is ops + trust (reviews) not partner discounts

yourLane.headline: Ops-led boutique (Us): premium feel, standardized system
promise: Fit-first: no ‘take home unless it fits’
Trust compounding: review flywheel as a moat
whatItCosts: More time per booking (structured fitting + checklist)
whyWorthIt: Lower disputes → less refunds, less time wasted
Inventory lasts longer → lower replacement capital
Higher referral + reviews → cheaper marketing over time

numbersLogic.assumptionNote: The point isn’t perfect accuracy; it’s to show patterns: disputes and rework are silent killers in rental businesses.

scenarios.name: Us (Ops-led Boutique)
scenarios.note: Slightly higher price, lower chaos cost

chaosCostModel.meaning: Expected hidden cost per booking = (disputeRate × refundCost) + (reworkHours × hourlyOpsCost). We aim to minimize this.

chart3.title: Why weekday utilization matters
chart3.subtitle: We don’t need massive volume. We need consistent bookings (and weekday products prevent idle fixed costs).

standoutLeft.title: How we stand out (without sounding arrogant)
bullets: We sell certainty: fit-first + readiness checklist.
We don’t negotiate policies — we empathize and follow system.
Every smooth experience becomes a review → future booking.

chinaRight.title: Borrow smart ideas from China marketplaces
bullets: Tiered packages: fewer choices, higher conversion.
Proof-content: cleaning + fit checks become trust marketing.
Operational pooling: partner tailors/cleaners for fast turnaround.
